rule: Sun & Saenko arXiv:1607.01719 §4 -- lambda equalises the classification and CORAL loss magnitudes at the end of training.
hard_rule: LOSS MAGNITUDES ONLY. TPR/AUROC/AUPRC/metric_suite/purity/curve_hook and every test_* cache split were made unreachable (coral_round4.test_label_lockout) for the whole calibration. gamma is never adjusted after seeing a metric.

coral_nb3.basis: loss magnitudes only -- no TPR, no AUROC, no test split was reachable while these series were produced (see test_label_lockout)

coral_nb0_control.basis: loss magnitudes only -- no TPR, no AUROC, no test split was reachable while these series were produced (see test_label_lockout)

one_gamma_rule: coral_weight is a PINNED key: BOTH arms must run the same gamma or they differ in two things and nb3-minus-nb0 stops isolating unfreezing. These per-arm values are diagnostics; ONE of them (or a declared compromise) must be chosen, written down, and passed to both --gamma flags.
